column1: # NOBUNAGA'S AMBITION: Shinsei (信長の野望·新生) on Android (keys in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "Game profiles on Android")
# Koei Tecmo's KTGL on NVN, SDK 13.3.2, update v65536 (1.0.1); Japanese, Traditional and Simplified Chinese (no English).
# 949 shaders (880 in RES/res_shader.bin, 69 GLSLC outputs in main) all translate; 70 of them are compute shaders that use subgroup
# ballot, and the device's own Adreno driver crashes in its shader compiler on them (037ce7a95ed81563 in the boot's compute prewarm,
# f4ba29462f05dd06 at the first one the game builds), so the port packs Mesa's Turnip (vulkan_driver turnip): tested with
# Turnip-26.2.3-EMULATOR and with GameSir's rutabaga 26.3.0-devel. With Turnip the 70 compute pipelines build in the background at boot
# (about 26-28 s) and nothing crashes.
# Tested 2026-11-22 on a Lenovo Legion Y700 TB321FU (Snapdragon 8 Gen 3, Adreno 750, Android 16) with zh-Hans: the opening movies, the
# tutorial's new game, the faction select, the campaign map, a retainer's advice, an in-game save the game commits (svdSC01.n16) and the
# pause menu. 30 fps as on the Switch in the campaign (frame time p50 33.0 ms, GPU 18-19 ms), 60 in the movies; no [RED] lines.
# Not yet tested: a battle, and the software keyboard (naming a custom officer).
